spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (मृडति) r. 9th cl. (-मृड्णाति)
1 To delight, to make happy.
2 To rejoice, to be happy or delighted.
r. 9th cl. (according to some authorities,)
To grind or pound.

The fire that completes an oblation.
f. (-डानी)
DURGĀ, the wife of ŚIVA.
E.
मृड to be pleased or delighted, aff. क, fem. aff. ङीष्, with आनुक् augment.

m. (-णः)
A child, a pupil.
E.
मृड to be pleased, Uṇādi aff. कङ्कण.

m. (-कः)
A deer.
E.
मृड to delight, Uṇādi aff. कीकन्.
